Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A cedar of per-task receipts records who did what, and the zenith of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
